content.short: Overnight Finance is a leading neutral-risk asset manager featuring USD+, a daily-rebasing yield-bearing stablecoin.
content.description: Overnight Finance is a decentralized asset management protocol delivering "neutral-risk" yields through sophisticated financial products. Its flagship USD+ stablecoin is fully collateralized by USDC and rebases daily, allowing holders to earn yield automatically without manual staking. The protocol generates returns by investing collateral into low-risk DeFi strategies like stablecoin lending and market-neutral liquidity provision. Operating on Polygon, Arbitrum, Base, and Optimism, Overnight Finance provides a robust framework for capital preservation and passive income for all Web3 participants.
